beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: Riley lays three cards face down. "Let's see the whole shape of this, not just today's."

beats.prompt: The past: the whole spinning run of the tour, every night a different pull of the wheel.
The present: the pause you're sitting in now that the tour's actually stopped.
The future: the thing you're about to have to blend.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Okay, quiz me. If blending them is supposedly the answer, why does it feel like nothing's actually landed yet?"

options.text: Blending takes time to settle — it's not instant, it's a process.
That means the blend already failed.
Landing has nothing to do with this card.

elaboration: Patience and experience refine raw experience into wisdom — the journey matters more than the destination right now.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "And if the mix ends up sounding closer to one side than the other, does that mean I picked after all?"

options.text: No — moderation isn't a fifty-fifty split, it's finding what actually balances.
Yes, that means you cheated and picked a side.
Balance doesn't matter here at all.

elaboration: Moderation means finding the right balance rather than swinging to extremes — it was never about an even split.

beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: "One thread ties all three: the spin that carried you here, the pause you needed after it, and the patient work of actually blending what you make next."

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Yeah — I think I've been waiting for the two sides to just resolve themselves. They won't. I actually have to sit down and mix them, and that's going to take longer than a weekend. That's fine, though."
